## ScaleAudioPitch_004f1510 — ScaleAudioPitch

**Summary:** Scales audio pitch and wheel RPM values by speed ratio based on physics random flags, then solves tire brush model. Part of audio/pitch scaling system.

**Frame-path:** ON_FRAME_PATH  
**Call frequency:** per-frame tick

**Called by:** AIDriverStructInit (00424790)

**Struct fields accessed:**

| Base | Offset | R/W | Init (literal → value) | Purpose |
|------|--------|-----|------------------------|---------|
| this | 0x3984 | RW | — | Pitch scale factor (scaled in bit 4 path) |
| this | 0x39A4 | R | — | EngineMaxRPM [CONFIRMED] |
| this | 0x39B0 | R | — | Engine RPM/speed value |
| this | 0x39F8 | R | — | Gear count (guard for bit 2 path) |
| this | 0x3BF4 | RW | — | Previous pitch/speed value (stored and used as divisor) |
| this | 0x4824 | R | — | Audio/engine parameter |

**Written-by note (persistence):**
- this 0x3984: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist
- this 0x3BF4: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist

**Globals referenced:**

| Address | Name | R/W | Role |
|---------|------|-----|------|
| 0059e43c | flt_59E43C | R | physics constant [DERIVED] (also: ` — float threshold for contact aging overflow) |
| 0059eb50 | dbl_59EB50 | R | InputScaleFactor [DERIVED] |
| 005ad240 | dbl_5AD240 | R | VehicleSimTickScale [DERIVED] |
| 005ad248 | dbl_5AD248 | R | DamageResponseScale [DERIVED] |
| 007d01c4 | byte_7D01C4 | R | PhysicsRandomFlags [DERIVED] (also: ` — Physics randomization flags (bit 2 = enable random speed noise) |

**Functions called:**

| Address | Name | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| 004e8010 | TireBrushModelForceSolver | Solves tire brush model forces after pitch scaling |
| 005881f0 | sub_5881F0 | Scales audio pitch parameter arrays |

**Guard conditions (deterministic — field vs literal):**

| Base | Offset | Test | Value | Field / meaning |
|------|--------|------|-------|-----------------|
| this | 0x39F8 | >= | 1 | Gear count (must have at least 1 gear for bit 2 scaling) |

**Guard interpretation:** byte_7D01C4 bitfield selects which scaling paths execute: bit 0 scales pitch arrays; bit 2 scales gear data if gear count (this+0x39F8) >= 1; bit 4 scales pitch scale factor (this+0x3984). PASSES per path when bit set and gear guard met.
